results.title: DECIPHERING THE DEFINITION OF ADVERSARIAL ROBUSTNESS FOR POST-HOC OOD DETECTORS
results.content: # DECIPHERING THE DEFINITION OF ADVERSARIAL ROBUSTNESS FOR POST-HOC OOD DETECTORS. This paper investigates the adversarial robustness of the 16 post-hoc detectors on several evasion attacks and discuss a roadmap towards adversarial defense in OOD detectors. Even adversarial training-based defense methods, effective against ID adversarial attacks, struggle against OOD adversarial examples [42]. We attack the pre-trained classifiers on the corresponding test sets and evaluate 16 post-hoc OOD detectors. Only two of them - Mahalanobis distance-based methods - [64, 65] show partly detection capabilities against the FGSM, PGD, and mPGD attacks on ResNet-50 with ImageNet-1K. In this study, we assess the performance of the 16 post-hoc OOD detectors in their ability to detect various evasive attacks. We conducted prominent white-box adversarial attacks, such as PGD and DeepFool, on the CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-1K datasets. In contrast, the adversarial robust OOD detectors are benchmarked more likely on the smaller and less complex CIFAR-10 dataset.

results.title: A novel method for improving the robustness of deep learning-based malware detectors against adversarial attacks - ScienceDirect
results.content: # A novel method for improving the robustness of deep learning-based malware detectors against adversarial attacks. An approach to combining adversarial attacks is proposed to analyse the robustness of malware detectors against attacks. In this work, ten neural network-based malware detectors are developed, with nine trained with a particular adversarial attack and one without such training. This paper studies the evasion rates of 10 adversarial attacks on 11 feed-forward neural network-based malware detectors for malware detection. A new approach to combining different adversarial attacks is proposed to analyse the robustness of learning-based malware detectors against evasion attacks. This section briefly highlights the related works in adversarial machine learning for malware detection. In this paper, a novel method has been developed that is robust in its ability to detect malware carrying out adversarial evasion attacks. ### Atmpa: Attacking machine learning-based malware visualization detection methods via adversarial examples. ### Securedroid: Enhancing security of machine learning-based detection against adversarial android malware attacks.

results.title: DECIPHERING THE DEFINITION OF ADVERSARIAL ROBUSTNESS FOR POST-HOC OOD DETECTORS
results.content: This paper investigates the adversarial robustness of 16 post-hoc detectors on several evasion attacks and discusses a roadmap toward adversarial defense in OOD detectors. This section discusses existing white-box evasion attacks, the benefits of post-hoc detectors, existing methods for detecting adversarial samples, and finally Grad-CAM, a tool for understanding the neural networks’ attention shift initiated by adversarial examples. Even adversarial training-based defense methods, effective against ID adversarial attacks, struggle against OOD adversarial examples [46]. Notably, recent post-hoc detectors predominantly utilize ImageNet-1K as their standard ID datasets, whereas adversarial robust OOD detectors are more commonly evaluated on the smaller CIFAR-10 dataset.
